name: GStreamer
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
summary: Plugin-based multimedia framework: gst-launch-1.0 wires elements (sources, decoders, compositors, encoders, sinks) into pipelines, and the C/Python APIs build the same graphs. Handles live capture, RTP/WebRTC and hardware codecs. Distinguishing strength: streaming and live graphs; for offline files FFmpeg is simpler.
use_when: Live or streaming pipelines (RTP, WebRTC, capture devices) that FFmpeg handles poorly
Appsink and appsrc hand-off of raw frames to code
avoid_when: Offline encode, trim or mux: ffmpeg-ffprobe
Frame-by-frame capture to video: ffmpeg-ffprobe on an image sequence

assessment.last_release: unknown (1.28.8 bug fix release, date not read)
assessment.rationale: Maintained (1.28.8 current, Homebrew stable). Pipeline-graph model suits live and streaming media, but offline encoding and compositing are better served by FFmpeg and MLT; keep as candidate for live pipelines only.

notes: 2026-10-29: Skill opportunity: further research first; a standalone live-pipeline skill may be useful after a reproducible streaming fixture and an existing-skill check.
